comment_on_enforcement: fail-open: hooks/check-llm-policy.sh warns locally (stderr, exit 0) when a model above the agent role's tier is requested. fail-closed makes the same violation exit 2 (block). Hard enforcement of the allowlist and of budget ceilings is delegated to the gateway: Claude Code availableModels/enforceAvailableModels (native since v2.1.175), OpenRouter spend limits, or the opencode-go subscription gateway. The hook is the soft local layer; the gateway is the hard layer.

zero-cost.description: Subscription-quota models (no metered spend). Never count against budget ceilings; usable as fallback for mechanical work when metered providers are rate-limited.

haiku.description: Mechanical work: formatting, symbol lookups, grep, simple renames, exploration, planning drafts.

sonnet.description: Implementation, feature work, code review, single-phase dispatch.

opus.description: Deep reasoning only: critic role, architecture review, cross-session synthesis, ADRs, >=5-step reasoning.

roleTiers.comment: Highest tier each agent role may request. Matches AGENTS.md model efficiency policy. Roles not listed resolve to 'default'.

budgets.comment: Ceilings per scope. Not enforceable from a local hook (the hook never sees metered cost); enforced gateway-side (OpenRouter limits, provider spend caps). Declared here so every scope has one canonical ceiling.

fallbackChain.comment: When the primary provider is rate-limited or unavailable, walk the chain in order. opencode-go is the zero-cost tier: its models consume subscription quota, not metered budget, so fallback to it never spends against budgets.*. A fallback event must be reported in the session evidence.

attributionTags.comment: Tags the gateway attaches to every metered request for cost attribution. <agent_role> and <budget_scope> are substituted per call; hook input fields agent_role and scope supply the values.
